title: Content & Video Production in Juno Beach, FL | Bates Media
description: Content and video production for Juno Beach, FL businesses — premium photo and video that stops the scroll and powers your ads, social, and website.
author: Jack Bates
answer: Bates Media produces premium content and video for Juno Beach, FL businesses — scroll-stopping photo and video built to power your ads, social media, and website, not just sit in a folder.
body_html:
Content & video production for Juno Beach businesses

Juno Beach is made for content — the pier, the ocean, the laid-back coastal feel are a natural backdrop that customers respond to. But a pretty location only matters if the content is built to perform. We turn that setting into photo and video that stops the scroll, builds your brand, and drives bookings.

Beautiful and built to convert — not one or the other.

What we produce

  • Brand photo & video — premium visuals for your website, ads, and profiles.
  • Short-form social video — reels and shorts built for reach and engagement.
  • Ad creative — content engineered to perform in paid campaigns.
  • Product & service shoots — show the work, the team, and the result.

Content with a job to do

Every shoot is planned around where it'll run and what it should achieve, so you get assets that perform and a library you can use for months.

Serving Juno Beach and beyond

We work with businesses across Juno Beach, Jupiter, Tequesta, Palm Beach Gardens, and North Palm Beach — and extend down through Palm Beach County as you grow.

faq.q: Do you use the Juno Beach setting in shoots?
faq.a: When it fits the brand, absolutely — the coastline and pier make a strong backdrop, but we always build the content around what converts for your business.

faq.q: Is the content built for ads or just for looks?
faq.a: Performance first — we produce creative designed to convert on social and in paid campaigns, while still looking premium.
Yes — we shoot across Juno Beach and the wider Palm Beach County area, on location or at your business.
